note: Recall fixture for round 4. Queries are how an agent actually asks; bodies are real-shaped memory notes. Query vocabulary is deliberately not a copy of the record vocabulary, so exact-term matching is not the only way to win.

records.title: GPU out of memory during eval
records.body: CUDA OOM when evals run while the full fine-tune is still resident on the card

records.title: Serialize GPU work
records.body: Run evaluation only after the fine-tune job releases the device, one workload at a time

records.title: save_pretrained died mid-run
records.body: The workspace loop device filled to 100 percent and the snapshot write failed halfway

records.title: Disk guard before snapshots
records.body: Skip snapshotting when free space is under 6 GB, keep one snapshot, delete it after scoring

records.title: WAL grows without bound
records.body: SQLite write-ahead log kept growing because nothing ever checkpointed it

records.title: Checkpoint on boot
records.body: Truncate the write-ahead log during recalibration so the database stays compact

records.title: Stdlib only by default
records.body: New tools use the standard library; any third-party package needs explicit approval

records.title: FTS5 over a custom index
records.body: Use the full-text extension shipped with SQLite instead of writing our own inverted index

records.title: tokeniser mismatch
records.body: Queries failed because the tokeniser split identifiers differently from the indexer

records.title: Normalize before indexing
records.body: Lowercase, strip punctuation and fold whitespace before anything reaches the index

records.title: Tool surface count
records.body: The MCP server exposes forty-four tools after the catalog namespace landed

records.title: Terse commits
records.body: Commit messages stay one line and imperative; no trailing punctuation

records.title: permission denied on write
records.body: Writing outside the allowlist root was refused by the guard and the run aborted

records.title: Confirm tokens for destructive verbs
records.body: Every delete or overwrite needs a one-shot confirmation token issued per run

records.title: JSON parse failure on tool output
records.body: The model emitted a malformed object and the tool call was rejected as invalid

records.title: Repair malformed tool calls
records.body: Retry once with the schema after trimming trailing text from the generated object

records.title: Budget caps for autonomous runs
records.body: A goal gets a hard turn limit and a wall clock limit; exceeding either pauses the run

records.title: Loop never stopped
records.body: A scheduled task kept firing because cancellation did not clear the pending timer

records.title: Cancel clears timers
records.body: Stopping a loop must drop every queued wakeup before reporting success

records.title: Search latency target
records.body: Catalog queries must answer in well under one hundred milliseconds from the bundled index

records.title: Rate limit from the forge API
records.body: The search endpoint returned four-oh-three after the quota window was exhausted

records.title: Wait for the reset window
records.body: Sleep until the quota header says the window reopened instead of retrying immediately

records.title: No vendoring of third-party code
records.body: Borrowed ideas are reimplemented cleanly; upstream source is never copied into the tree

records.title: License is copyleft
records.body: The candidate used AGPL terms so only the idea could be studied, not the source

records.title: Check the license before adopting
records.body: Permissive terms allow clean-room work; missing terms mean all rights reserved

records.title: Catalog size
records.body: Forty-eight hundred unique repositories across sixty-five search sections

records.title: Measure before claiming a win
records.body: Every optimisation ships with a before and after number in the changelog

records.title: Test suite skipped silently
records.body: Discovery found zero tests because the directory had no package marker

records.title: Run discovery explicitly
records.body: Use unittest discovery with an explicit start directory so empty results fail loudly

records.title: Import path missing the package root
records.body: The module failed to import because the repository root was not on the path

records.title: Add repo root to sys.path
records.body: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])) at the top of a script

records.title: Timeout on a slow command
records.body: A subprocess was killed after the two minute ceiling and reported no output

records.title: Bound every subprocess
records.body: Always pass a timeout and cap captured output so a hung child cannot stall the run

records.title: Read-only surfaces never write
records.body: Catalog and query commands must not touch the filesystem unless an explicit path is given

records.title: Encoding broke on emoji
records.body: A note with emoji crashed the writer because the file was opened without a declared encoding

records.title: Declare encoding everywhere
records.body: Open text files with utf-8 and errors set to replace so exotic characters survive

records.title: Flash notes are fast
records.body: Key-value notes resolve in well under fifty milliseconds including parsing

records.title: Errors before prose
records.body: When a command fails the reason comes first and the hint second

records.title: Secret leaked into a log line
records.body: An access token appeared in captured output and had to be redacted retroactively

records.title: Redact before storing
records.body: Strip credential-shaped strings at capture time rather than cleaning them later

records.title: Vector index stale after edit
records.body: Similarity results were wrong because the embeddings were not refreshed after records changed

records.title: Invalidate on mutation
records.body: Key the cached vectors by row count and newest update so edits trigger a rebuild

records.title: Deterministic hashes across processes
records.body: Never use Python's built-in string hash for anything reproducible; it is salted

records.title: Native binary is optional
records.body: The launcher falls back to the Python implementation when the compiled tool is missing

records.title: Cron drift doubled the schedule
records.body: Two timers were registered for one task and the job ran twice per interval
